name: Kōjō no Tsuki (荒城の月)
pages: Wikimedia Commons, "Kojo no tsuki re mineur.svg" (CC0)
about: Rentarō Taki's setting (1901) of Bansui Doi's poem "The Moon over the Ruined Castle", in D minor with Taki's raised seventh, as on the Commons score. Notes as pitch:beats, quarter notes as beats, / after a phrase.
